content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

I am able to offer insight on the sophisticated suite of products and services Averon Trust Bank has available in order for business owners to create efficiencies, monitor cash flow, and improve security. I’ll come to your place of business to set them up for you, and am always available to answer questions. I’ll work alongside you as your business continues to evolve and grow. 

A Little About Me

Prior to joining Averon Trust, I worked for Credit Agricole Corporate & Investment Bank in New York where I gained experience as a Corporate Banker and Relationship Manager, assisting clients with cash management and commercial banking products.

Since relocating to North Stonington, CT almost six years ago, I serve as Chair of the Town of North Stonington’s Sustainability Committee, I’m a member of Fairview’s Gala Planning Committee, a Rotarian in the Norwich Rotary Club, and volunteer weekly for The Light House Homestead and Stables.

I graduated from Georgetown University with a BA in Government and French and speak fluent French.  I previously taught English in a primary school in France.
